gates.description: Verify dev swarm scheduler accurately claims eligible tasks when capacity tokens are available and respects preflight.

gates.description: Verify 5 consecutive representative coding canaries execute locally on AMD node .5 with zero external spend and terminal PASS.

gates.name: Worker Restart and Recovery without Duplicate Writers
gates.description: Verify worker recovery mechanisms resume task progress cleanly without duplicate DB writers or lost leases.

gates.name: Inconsistent Task/Run State Reconciliation
gates.description: Verify nonterminal reconciler resolves stale leases, orphaned tasks, and out-of-sync run records.

gates.name: Bounded Retry Stop on Model/Test Failures
gates.description: Verify circuit breaker halts runaway retries and transitions to review/failed on exhausted budgets.

gates.name: Codex Read-Only Canary with Pinned GPT-5.6

gates.name: Antigravity Gemini 3.7 Canary

gates.name: Cursor Auth Probe and Grok/Auto Policy Rejection
gates.description: Verify Cursor is strictly pinned to Composer 2.5 and immediately blocks Grok and Auto/Router requests before execution.

gates.name: AMD ROCm Concurrency Benchmark Ramp
gates.description: Verify AMD node .5 vLLM inference latency and throughput under multi-request concurrency.

gates.name: Mixed WorkForce/Development Load SLO Verification
gates.description: Verify P0/P1 production service reservations protect latency while background development tasks run.

gates.name: Multi-Project Fair Queueing Verification
gates.description: Verify WeightedFairQueue allocates execution slots fairly without starvation of low-frequency projects.

gates.name: Canonical Repository Clean Main Verification
gates.description: Verify all canonical runtime code passes linting/tests and main tracking is synchronized.

gates.name: System Stability Soak Test
gates.description: Verify multi-cycle scheduling and execution stability over sustained operation without error loops.
